# Inwoovation Precision CEA & AgTech Engineering Portal (inwoovation.com)

> Institutional-grade open engineering portal for Controlled Environment Agriculture (CEA), Venlo glasshouse structural & thermodynamic design, psychrometric microclimate steering, and European/North American horticultural economics.

## Core Flagship Engineering Suites
- [VenloCAD 3D v3.2 Parametric CAD & Structural Engine](https://inwoovation.com/tools/venlocad-3d.html): WebGL 3D parametric greenhouse structural engine (NEN 3859 / EN 13031-1 wind & snow load, coupled ATU semi-closed thermodynamics, 1D aluminum bin-packing, DXF/STL/GLB export, and multi-currency CPQ PDF generator).
- [EU Greenhouse Energy Audit (DIN V 18599 / BLE 40%) & Hofnachfolge ROI Simulator](https://inwoovation.com/tools/eu-greenhouse-energy-hofnachfolge-roi-simulator.html): German federal energy efficiency grant (BLE 40%), BEHG/ETS-2 carbon tax abatement, and 10-year farm succession (Ertragspacht / Stille Beteiligung) buyout financial modeler.
- [Deutscher Gartenbau-Meister & KTBL-Standard Hub](https://inwoovation.com/meister.html): KTBL Deckungsbeitrag (DB I & II), DIN V 18599 heating load, QS-GAP 2026 / ToBRFV disinfection (Menno Florades), and German Master Horticulturist (Gärtnermeister) examination tools.
- [Master 41 Enterprise CEA Tools Directory](https://inwoovation.com/tools/index.html): Complete suite of 41 zero-latency browser calculators covering VPD, Mollier psychrometrics, Penman-Monteith evapotranspiration, Hoagland/Sonneveld nutrient stoichiometry, ATES geothermal storage, and MPC climate control.
- [Smart Farm Biophysical Simulator Lab (15 Engines)](https://inwoovation.com/smartfarm/index.html): Interactive simulators for VPD, 3-way mixing valves, A/B fertigation, peak heat loss, and Wave Function Collapse (WFC) layout optimization.

## Peer-Reviewed Engineering Monographs & Encyclopedias
- [78 Engineering Monographs (152 Multilingual Editions in EN / DE / JA)](https://inwoovation.com/guides.html): Comprehensive research library covering greenhouse thermodynamics, stomatal conductance, autonomous AI reinforcement learning (MPC), high-wire crop steering, and European energy transition.
- [AgTech Botanical & Biochemical Wiki (52 Modules)](https://inwoovation.com/wiki/index.html): Deep physiological references on Rubisco kinetics, PIP aquaporin gating, calcium xylem transport, and crop-specific steering.
- [Global Greenhouse Climate Atlas (40 Regional Hubs)](https://inwoovation.com/climate/index.html): Empirical monthly solar DLI, heating degree-days, and structural design benchmarks across Westland (NL), Bleiswijk (NL), Straelen (DE), Knoblauchsland/Nürnberg (DE), Almería (ES), Leamington (CA), Salinas (US), and Gimje (KR).
- [Commercial Crop Steering Atlas (10 Crops)](https://inwoovation.com/crops/index.html): Phenological VPD, DLI, and root-zone EC/WC% targets for Tomato, Cucumber, Sweet Pepper, Strawberry, Lettuce, Rose, Phalaenopsis, Basil, Eggplant, and Cannabis.
- [Deutscher Meisterfunk Podcast (Daily Audio & Transcripts)](https://inwoovation.com/podcasts/index.html): Daily bilingual/German horticultural science and news podcast with full RSS feed (`https://inwoovation.com/podcasts/feed.xml`).
